eas_text: A civil authority has issued A REQUIRED WEEKLY TEST for the following counties or areas: Idaho; Lincoln, MT; Malheur, OR; Spokane, WA; at 2:14 PM on AUG 3, 2016 Effective until 2:29 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The Idaho Bureau of Homeland Security has issued a Required Weekly Test of the Emergency Alert System for the entire State of Idaho, Lincoln County Montana, Spokane County and Malheur County. If this had been an actual emergency, instructions or information would have followed this message.
